# Tokyo Night

Tokyo Night applies Tokyonight-inspired color schemes to Obsidian in Night and Light variants. Storm and Moon styles are included and driven through the Style Settings plugin. The recorded description also lists extended checkbox and status markers for tasks such as incomplete, done, canceled, scheduled and important.

![Tokyo Night screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tcmmichaelb139/obsidian-tokyonight/HEAD/dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Tokyo Night"
    author: "tcmmichaelb139"
    repo:   "tcmmichaelb139/obsidian-tokyonight"
    slug:   "tokyo-night"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/tokyo-night"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/tcmmichaelb139/obsidian-tokyonight"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tcmmichaelb139/obsidian-tokyonight/HEAD/dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Tokyonight-inspired color schemes to Obsidian with Night and Light variants. Use included Storm and Moon styles with Style Settings support and get extended checkbox/status markers for tasks such as incomplete, done, canceled, scheduled, important and more."
}
```
